description.en:
The most useful supernatural power in the world. The ability to make someone you dislike disappear from your sight with just one thumb - a power bestowed only to me. Making full use of this convenient ability, I have become the shadow ruler at work. The other day, my workplace manager, Kitagaki, was a horrible sexual harasser, so I used my power to sack him and settle the situation. Just when I thought peace had returned, someone approached the beautiful Yoshino-san, whom I have my eye on! His name is Osawa; he's a positive person with a strong sense of justice, the complete opposite of me. Damn it! What an eyesore… I guess I'll just get rid of him too…

A panicky comic in which the warped thinking of a young man who's discovered power causes major upheaval!!
___

description.ja: この世で一番使える超能力。それは親指一本で嫌いな奴を目の前から消すことができる――俺だけに与えられた力だ。この便利な能力を大いに使って、俺は職場で影の支配者となる。先日も職場の北垣部長がセクハラする最低な奴だったので、力を使ってクビにし環境を整えた。平和になった…と思った途端、俺が狙っている美人な吉野さんに近づく輩が！俺とは正反対の正義感の強くポジティブな大沢だ。くそっ…！目障りだな…。コイツも削除するか…。力を知ってしまった青年の歪んだ思考が大きな異変を巻き起こすパニックコミック!!【ズズズキュン！】
